R0245.title: Sensitive Information Leakage in Model Output
R0245.definition: Models disclose training data, system prompts, or internal materials in conversations, summaries, or generated code.

references.title: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications

R0245.description:
Sensitive information leakage in model output occurs when a model reveals training data, system prompts, internal documents, secret fragments, or customer information during chat, summarization, code generation, or tool use. It can be triggered by prompt manipulation, context pollution, or permission mistakes.

The risk grows when models connect to enterprise knowledge bases and business systems. Controls need input and output review, context minimization, permission binding, and sensitive data detection.
R0245.influence: Model output leakage can expose prompts, internal documents, customer data, or secrets through AI applications.
